title: 运维命令
implementation: doctor: OBS-04 diagnostics bundle (redacted config summary, build identity, status checks)
verify: offline installation check - migration version, startup consistency, foreign key integrity; exit 1 on failure
readiness: the same check set printed as named readiness reasons for monitors
support-bundle: OBS-04 report plus table row counts and retention summary, written 0600 with a covering digest

checks.honest_failure: PASS: unmigrated empty database reports schema reason instead of a fabricated pass; missing database file errors instead of being created
checks.runtime: PASS: serve created a database, then verify reported PASS (database_ping/schema_migrations/startup_consistency/foreign_key_check all ok) and support-bundle wrote a digest-stamped 0600 file with table counts
checks.offline: PASS: all commands run without qui/qB or network access

scope_note: Commands are additive to serve/doctor/version; the readiness check set is intentionally shared with verify so monitors and operators see identical reasons.
